comment: SGX v3 structural, cryptographic and collateral cases: deterministic local keys and a synthetic Intel-shaped P-256 hierarchy, plus pinned Intel QVL sample data and the Intel SGX Root CA; no hardware isolation claim.

suites.source: Deterministic SGX v3 quote signed with a fixed P-256 attestation key; structure per Intel DCAP Quote Library API
Quote signature checks over header || report with fixed P-256 keys
QE report binding and signature with a fixed P-256 PCK leaf
P-256 PCK chain path validation with fixed certificates; P-384 is refused, not ignored
End-to-end production DCAP verification: quote, QE, P-256 PCK chain, then TCB Info and QE Identity signed by a TCB signing certificate, PCK and root CA CRLs and freshness at a caller-supplied time
Collateral components: QVL TcbInfo / EnclaveIdentity parsing and level selection, convergeTcbStatuses, TCB signing chain, CRLs and the PCK SGX extension
RFC 5280 path, trust-anchor and critical-extension cases generated with fixed P-256 keys

Intel QVL d12717e3f1f2ab81313f88001fd902b5ef5f9c8c Src/AttestationApp/sampleData; BSD-3-Clause (INTEL-LICENSE.txt). Type-5 variant replaces the type-1 certificate locator with the matching vendor PCK chain; signed bytes are unchanged.
Intel-signed QVL sample collateral (BSD-3-Clause, INTEL-LICENSE.txt) and the production Intel SGX Root CA
